# Example Corp Employee Handbook

Welcome to Example Corp. This handbook explains how the company works day to day, from office hours to time off. It is a synthetic document written for testing, and every name, number, and policy in it is made up. Read it once when you join and come back to it whenever a question about routine matters comes up.

Office hours run from nine in the morning to five in the afternoon, Monday through Friday. Teams may agree on different core hours as long as someone is available to answer questions from other teams. Remote work is allowed up to three days a week, and each team lead keeps a simple shared calendar showing who is in the office.

Every employee receives twenty days of paid leave per year, plus public holidays. Leave requests go to your team lead at least two weeks ahead for anything longer than three days. Unused leave carries over to the next year, up to a maximum of five days, and anything beyond that expires at the end of March.

Equipment is issued on your first day: a laptop, a monitor, and a headset. Report lost or broken equipment to the help desk within one business day. Personal software may not be installed on company laptops without approval from the help desk, and all laptops must stay encrypted and locked when unattended.

Expense claims are submitted through the finance portal within thirty days of the purchase. Attach an itemized receipt for every claim. Travel must be booked through the approved travel desk, and economy class is the default for flights shorter than six hours unless your manager approves an exception in writing.

Questions about anything in this handbook can go to the people team. They answer most messages within two business days and keep a list of frequently asked questions on the internal wiki, which is updated every quarter.
